prompt: If the destination change is confirmed today, how should P8-M be treated until verification tomorrow?
promptZh: 如果今天確認目的地已更改，在明天查核前應如何處理 P8-M？
evidence: Keep P8-M visible until tomorrow’s verification, but mark it “reference only” as soon as the systems team confirms the destination change.

options.text: Keep it visible and mark it “reference only.”
options.zh: 保持可見並標為「僅供參考」。
options.whyZh: 確認後要加上標示，不是移除。

options.text: Hide it immediately without changing its label.
options.why: It must remain visible until verification and be labeled once the change is confirmed.
options.whyZh: 查核前須保持可見，並在確認變更後加上標示。

options.text: Keep it as a second export destination.
options.zh: 保留為第二個匯出目的地。
options.why: Each press has only one export destination.
options.whyZh: 每台沖床只能有一個匯出目的地。

options.text: Transfer its duplicated rows to P8-R and delete it.
options.zh: 把重複時段資料列轉到 P8-R，然後刪除 P8-M。
options.why: No old time rows should be copied and P8-M must remain visible.
options.whyZh: 不可複製舊時段資料列，而且 P8-M 必須保持可見。

explanationZh: 確認後要加上標示，不是移除。
